thread:
maria: heads-up — we're rolling out a new SI intake duty roster to cut double-claims and speed handoffs. TL;DR: 48h claim window, daily roster (region rotations), CRM tagging (#si-claim + si_owner field), and escalation to partner-ops if unclaimed >72h. Putting draft rules below, pls shout if anything missing.

jon: sounds good. one ask — for enterprise deals >$250k, can we extend claim window to 72h? those usually need more context and legal touches.

lee: quick Q — how do we treat accounts that already have a field advocate assigned? let SI claim or require a formal handoff?

sophia: CRM plan: add custom field `si_owner` + a stage lock for 48h once claim is set. example claim tag for activity: `#si-claim integrator=IntegratorCo owner=maria region=EMEA`. We'll also emit an automated reminder at 24h if still unclaimed.

maria: exact — example claim format in Confluence page. I'll draft the short playbook. For exceptions (jon's >$250k), we can add a rule: deals with ARR/TCV >= 250k get a 72h window.

sam-partnerops: I can run week 1 roster and post rotations (NA/EMEA/APAC). I'll create a shared calendar and assign primary/backup for each day. Also recommend a 'duty handover' note posted at EOD.

marketbot: [bot] Marketplace intake created: IntegratorCo — ACME Corp (demo request) — assigned to intake-queue.

jon: escalation flow proposal: after 72h unclaimed -> post to #partner-ops-escalate and ping @ops-lead; if still no owner after 96h escalate to CRO/AE. Also enable an auto-reminder at 24h to the on-call duty.

lee: one edge-case — hardware partner deals that come via marketplace-hw should probably bypass standard SI claim flow and route to hw-ops first. SI should only get notified, not claim, unless hw-ops flags for SI involvement. worth documenting.

sophia: agreed — add routing rule: if primary_channel == `marketplace-hw` then route to hw-ops; create ticket and cc SI thread. I'll add the rule to the routing table in Confluence and the intake webhook config. Example webhook payload snippet:
```json
{
  "source":"marketplace-hw",
  "partner":"IntegratorCo",
  "account":"ACME Corp",
  "route":"hw-ops",
  "notify":"si-intake"
}
```

maria: perfect — I'll update the Confluence doc (https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/si-duty-roster) with the claim format, exception rules, escalation steps, and the rotation calendar. Plan to run a 2-week pilot starting Monday; sam will operate the roster. Thanks all :raised_hands:

jon: +1 to pilot. can we add a short slide for AE enablement so they know how to interpret the tag/owner? 1 slide max.

sam-partnerops: noted — I'll make the slide and drop in #partner-ops before EOD Fri.

maria: awesome — final ask: everyone react with :eyes: once you've skimmed the Confluence playbook after I post it tomorrow so we can go live Monday.
